chunks: Then he started striking them down with his right hand.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet do with his right hand at the Battle of Badr?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) striking the enemy ranks with his right hand, symbolizing divine agency behind his physical action. It underscores the concept of *fi'l al-Rasul* (the Prophet's action) being an extension of God's will, a key theme in understanding the spiritual authority of the Ahl al-Bayt.
